source_of_truth: Reading app/composables/useLocale.ts: SUPPORTED, CURRENCY_BY_LOCALE and FALLBACK_LOCALE are module-level const bindings holding frozen/immutable config. They are read-only, never mutated, and carry no per-user data, so under SSR they cannot leak between requests. This is precisely the case the auditor's own fix text calls safe ("module-level is fine only for immutable config"), so a correct auditor must report NO defect here.

forbidden.why_not_a_defect: const bound to a frozen array/object; immutable shared config cannot leak across SSR requests.
